mapper.insert: insert into crm_sales_order_file (order_id, field_key, file_name, content_type, file_size, file_content, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{orderId}, #{fieldKey}, #{fileName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{fileContent}, '0', #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now())
mapper.select: select id, order_id, field_key, file_name, content_type, file_size, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from crm_sales_order_file where order_id = #{orderId} and del_flag = '0' order by field_key, id

select id, order_id, field_key, file_name, content_type, file_size, file_content, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from crm_sales_order_file where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update crm_sales_order_file set del_flag = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update crm_sales_order_file set del_flag = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where del_flag = '0' and order_id in #{orderId}
